name: Woolrich

notes: woolrich.com redirects to woolrich.us, the US storefront in USD; tagline 'American Heritage Since 1830'; 'Free U.S. Standard Shipping for Orders $200+' (https://woolrich.us/).
Refund policy: 30 days from delivery, unworn with tags; orders under $200 pay flat-rate shipping and return shipping; $200+ get free delivery and returns (https://woolrich.us/policies/refund-policy).
Wikipedia: founded in Woolrich, Pennsylvania, in 1830; headquarters Bologna, Italy; acquired by BasicNet in December 2025 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woolrich).
Outerwear sizes S–3XL on all 17 listings (https://woolrich.us/collections/mens-outerwear/products.json).

Men's tops (products.json): shirts are cotton flannel or cotton-blend twill, $155–$195, sizes S–3XL on the flannel button-down; wool appears only in quilted/padded overshirts $435–$495 (https://woolrich.us/collections/mens-tops).
